units.source_text: “我很清楚K的果断性格，也很了解唯独在这件事上，他如此优柔寡断的缘由。

en.t: I knew K's decisive nature very well, and I also understood why, in this matter alone, he was so irresolute.

units.source_text: 即是说，我自以为深谙其禀性，又彻底把握了其‘出圈’的可能性，而暗自得意起来。

en.t: In other words, I secretly grew pleased with myself, thinking that I deeply understood his nature and had thoroughly grasped the possibility of his making an exception.

units.source_text: 但是，当我反复回味着他说过的‘下决心’时，我那得意的心情便渐渐失了色，最后竟心神不安起来。

en.t: However, as I turned over again and again in my mind the resolve he had spoken of, my complacency gradually lost its color, until at last I became uneasy.

units.source_text: 因为我想到，很可能现在这种情况对他而言并不是‘出圈’。

en.t: For it occurred to me that perhaps this situation was not, for him, an exception at all.

units.source_text: 因为我开始怀疑，他把一举解决所有疑虑、苦闷和懊恼的最后手段，都藏在心里了。

en.t: For I began to suspect that he was hiding in his heart the final means of settling all his doubts, anguish, and torment at one stroke.

units.source_text: 我用这一新的光照再次去审视他那‘下决心’之语时，顿时惊出一身冷汗。

en.t: When I examined his word resolve again in this new light, I suddenly broke out in a cold sweat.

units.source_text: 如果当时我以这种惊异的心情，再次公平地思考一遍他所说的‘下决心’的含意就好了。

en.t: If only, at that time, with that feeling of astonishment, I had once more considered fairly what he meant by resolve.

units.source_text: 可悲的是，我竟瞎了眼，我只把这个词理解为他要向小姐展开追求攻势的意思了，

en.t: Sadly, I was blind; I understood the word only to mean that he intended to press his pursuit of the young lady,

units.source_text: 我以为K要在爱情上施展他那果断的性格，便是他的‘决心’。

en.t: I thought that K's resolve meant that he would bring his decisive nature to bear in love.
